newsitem.title: USA: Vencor raises Colo. Medtech stake to 39 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vencor raises Colo. Medtech stake to 39 pct.

text.p: Colorado MEDtech Inc said Wednesday Vencor Inc, its largest shareholder, raised its stake in the company to 39 percent by buying 2.0 million common shares and exercising warrants.
Before the transaction, Vencor, a long-term healthdare company, held a 21 percent stake in the company, said Greg Gould, Colorado MEDtech's comptroller.
Gould declined to say how much Vencor paid for the latest share purchase.
Colorado MEDtech designs and manufactures electronic and electromechanical products and software systems for the medical device industry.
